title: Jersey Royal Potato Tacos
description: Mexican-inspired tacos filled with crispy Jersey Royal potatoes, topped with a floral salsa and fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: Jersey Royal potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into 1 cm wedges

instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C.
Fry potato wedges in batches until golden and crispy.
In a separate pan, warm Ukrainian rye flour over low heat.
Add Aerated water to the pan and stir to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until pliable.
Divide the dough into 6 equal pieces and shape into tacos.
Fry tacos in hot oil until crispy and golden.
Fill tacos with fried potato wedges, toasted babka, and chopped cilantro.
Drizzle with floral oil and serve with a squeeze of lime juice.
